Api_key_tip: API Key authentication: Authenticate by including 'Bearer <API-Key>' in the Authorization header of the request. Requires an API Key.
AK_SK_tip: AK/SK authentication for jiuwen models: Authenticate by signing requests with AK (Access Key ID) and SK (Secret Access Key). Requires both AK and SK.
APP_code_tip: App-code authentication: Authenticate by including '<App-code>' in the X-Apig-Appcode header. The input field label will display 'App code'.
custom_tip: Custom authentication: Authenticate using custom request headers.
IAM_tip: IAM authentication: Authenticate using a user token obtained via IAM credentials.
HisIAM_tip: HIS authentication: Authenticate using account and secret password.
HisSGOV_tip: SGOV authentication: Authenticate using APPID and credential.
HMAC_tip: To encrypt and call the request via AK (Access Key ID) /SK (Secret Access Key), both AK and SK must be provide.
temperature_desc: temperature: Higher values produce more random outputs; lower values make outputs more focused and deterministic. We recommend setting only one of temperature or top_p.
top_p_desc: top_p: Controls output diversity. Higher values increase randomness and variety. We recommend setting only one of top_p or temperature.
prompt_completion_count: n: Number of completions to generate per prompt. Note: This rapidly consumes your token quota. Use with caution.
presence_penalty: A number between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values discourage repetition of words already used, encouraging novel ones.
frequency_penalty_desc: frequency_penalty: A number between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values discourage common words and phrases, favoring less frequent ones.
enable_content_safety_monitoring: Enable content safety monitoring to filter sensitive content related to politics, pornography, violence, etc. Use with caution.
disable_content_safety_monitoring: Disable content safety monitoring. Sensitive content related to politics, pornography, violence, etc., will not be filtered. Use with caution.
